column1: # The first field is a fixture path or shell glob matched against a changed
# path. A bare directory wildcard such as test-data/real/* covers every
# descendant and the directory itself, including deleted paths; a row such as
# test-data/real/*.pdf remains an extension filter. The second field is exactly
# one owner: the source path of a declared test target under crates/<crate>/,
# including a custom target outside tests/, or crates/<crate>#lib for a fixture
# read by a crate's unit tests. The runner resolves the source path through
# cargo metadata, so the target's declared name is used. A row contributes that
# target only; changing a test target's source is handled by the normal
# The table is intentionally explicit rather than inferring ownership from
# string search: a fixture may be read through a helper, a directory walk, or a
# list of stems. A fixture with no matching row is unknown and selects the full
# workspace; new fixtures should get a row here when their owner is known.
# Keep owner paths relative to the repository root and tab-separate the fields.
# Small fixtures beside the corpus, read directly by a test.
# The corpus-wide suites read the directory as a set, so their rows stay broad.
# Layout reads only PDFs and all other targets are named fixture by fixture below.

# opens it directly, so it intentionally has no row.
